name: Multiples.vc
description:
Access public comps, M&A multiples and VC data, straight from Claude.
Multiples MCP delivers investment-grade valuation intelligence for investment banking, PE and VC ecosystem.
Try queries like "cybersecurity strategic M&A buyers" "median SaaS public NTM multiples," or "biggest VC rounds in Europe this year" and get structured, sourced answers back instantly.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Multiples.vc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Multiples.vc to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://multiples.vc/api/mcp-server/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Multiples.vc MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multiples.vc lists 13 MCP tools, including multiples_compute_deal_stats, multiples_get_time_series_aggregate, multiples_get_time_series_snapshot, multiples_get_time_series_stats, multiples_list_taxonomy_values, multiples_search_buyer_rankings, multiples_search_companies_by_name, multiples_search_funding_rounds, multiples_search_investor_rankings, multiples_search_ma_deals, multiples_search_public_companies, and multiples_search_sector_rankings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Multiples.vc?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Multiples.vc in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Multiples.vc requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Multiples.vc is developed by Multiples.vc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
